changelog.changes: Critical Syntax Bug Fix & Engine Hardening: Fixed fatal PowerShell ParseException at line 1419 character 16 caused by an extra closing parenthesis in the XAML base64 join statement (') -join ''))' -> ') -join '')'); verified 100% clean abstract syntax tree and balanced brackets across entire engine; updated internal XAML headers to v043; synced standalone CMD directly to Vladimir's Desktop D:\MEGA\DOCS\desktop\GIN-Win-Optimizer_v043.cmd.

Comprehensive Deep Optimization Suite: 1) Enforced UAC slider to absolute minimum ('Never Notify' / EnableLUA=0, ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin=0, ConsentPromptBehaviorUser=0, PromptOnSecureDesktop=0, FilterAdministratorToken=0); 2) Completely uninstalled and purged Cortana assistant packages & provisioned stubs; 3) Added automatic background updater purge for Google Chrome, Brave, and Cent Browser (stopping gupdate/brave services, disabling tasks, deleting all Update folders and disabling background mode); 4) Verified 100% Windows Update lock; 5) Completely purged demo 1-month Microsoft Office stubs, OneNote, and commercial trial bloatware (Clipchamp, Spotify, Disney, Netflix, TikTok, sponsored games); 6) Enabled chk_srv_pca (disable PcaSvc), chk_srv_trkwks (disable TrkWks NTFS network tracking), and chk_srv_iphlpsvc (disable IPv6 transition) by default and in all presets; 7) Implemented maximum full SSD & NVMe M.2 optimization (TRIM enable, disable LastAccess, NtfsMemoryUsage=2 high-IOPS cache, disable SysMain/Prefetcher/ReadyBoost, disable scheduled HDD defrag, active multi-drive ReTrim); 8) Enforced elevated Administrator disk cleanup; 9) Eliminated popup completion MessageBox in favor of prominent in-log terminal banner.

Critical Network ServiceDll & Total Zero-UAC Fix: Fixed destructive New-Item -Force bug on HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanWorkstation\Parameters that wiped ServiceDll (causing Error 2 'The system cannot find the file specified' and dropping mapped network drives R:, S:, Z: across reboots); enforced explicit ServiceDll=%SystemRoot%\System32\wkssvc.dll preservation; enforced EnableLUA=0 in HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System for permanent 100% elimination of all UAC prompts across all Windows editions; synced to desktop D:\MEGA\DOCS\desktop.
